summary:

- Refund of a duplicate charge this month.
- Fix for repeated upload failures (ERR_5012).

- Confirmed double charge: two identical paid $490.00 invoices on 2026-09-02 (INV-8804, INV-8805).
- ERR_5012 = upload rejected by storage (size limit, file type, or 15-min token expiry).
- Open incident INC-2291: intermittent eu-west-1 rejections on uploads >50 MB (~3% affected); workaround is retry from a fresh page load.

- Whether the upload issue is customer-side (file size/type) or attributable to INC-2291; if the customer's files are within limits and retries fail, decide on next steps or escalation.
